gaussian_diffusion.role: multi-step reference, only if justified by compute

backbone.note: identical architecture to the cube-triple arms; the count 63,241,642 differs from cube-triple's 63,249,715 only through the 37-D versus 46-D observation dimension. Verified on CPU for both arms before launch; the trainer enforces it at run time and aborts on mismatch.

compute_gate: Run arms sequentially on one GPU. Stage 1 only is authorized by this manifest; stages 2 and 3 require the stage-1 result first. Do not launch while another process holds GPU memory.

decision_rule.if_all_near_zero: If BC, Flow, Shortcut, and Diffusion all remain near 0 to a few percent, stop treating pure-BC OGBench cube manipulation as the main benchmark. The next research question becomes whether value guidance/RL is fundamentally required, or whether entity-structured generative policies can improve matters without a critic.
decision_rule.if_flow_or_diffusion_exceeds_bc: cube-double becomes valuable: run a controlled NFE sweep and independent training seeds.
decision_rule.no_new_method: Do not implement a new method until cube-double indicates the regime.

evaluation.environment: cube-double-play singletask via the pinned native OGBench harness
evaluation.note: evaluated with the goal-conditioned -play-v0 environment, matching the published Table 2 setting; singletask variants are NOT comparable
evaluation.pairing_requirement: all arms evaluated on identical episode seeds; a per-arm hash over initial and goal states must match

excluded_arms.auxiliary_improved_meanflow: cancelled with the rest of the iMF line
excluded_arms.improved_meanflow: cancelled; MVP (ICLR 2026) occupies the MeanFlow/cube-task intersection

external_comparison_rule: Compare only against OGBench Table 2 -play-v0 baselines. Do NOT compare against MVP/FMQ/QC singletask numbers: per the official repository those target a fundamentally different problem formulation.

gpu_policy.central_seed_rule: Any training seed used for a central claim must be run on an uncontended GPU. Exploratory runs under contention may inform direction but their throughput, wall-clock, and latency numbers must not be reported.
gpu_policy.measurement_rule: All compute estimates must come from measured runtimes on an uncontended GPU. Never extrapolate high-NFE latency linearly from low-NFE timings: doing so underestimated 100-NFE cost by 3x (260 ms projected vs 789 ms measured).
gpu_policy.rule: Do not launch EC-Diffuser/OGBench GPU jobs while unrelated Isaac Lab jobs occupy the GPU. Verify the GPU is uncontended immediately before launch and record any concurrent processes.

methods_note: derived from arms[*].config; this is the key train_phase7_pilot.py reads. arms[*] additionally records role and inference NFE for evaluation.

preregistered_outcomes.bc_floor_matches: behavior_cloning matches the generative arms -> generative modeling is not earning its cost here; a publishable negative result
preregistered_outcomes.bc_is_the_bottleneck: every arm including Gaussian@100 performs near zero -> BC without a critic cannot do this task, and the task cannot discriminate generative objectives for us; report and stop
preregistered_outcomes.low_nfe_sufficient: Flow at 1-2 NFE approaches Flow at 8 and Gaussian at 100 -> NFE is not the bottleneck under BC on this task
preregistered_outcomes.nfe_matters: Flow collapses at 1-2 NFE and recovers by 4-8 -> integration/objective is the operative variable

question: Under pure behavior cloning at low NFE, with no critic, how far can a policy get on OGBench cube-double-play -- a task with documented headroom where GCIQL reaches 40 +/- 5 while GCBC reaches only 1 +/- 1?
questions_to_answer_after_stage_1: Does Flow materially exceed the BC floor?
Does performance change meaningfully with NFE?
Does Diffusion outperform low-NFE Flow under the same BC training paradigm?
Is failure primarily a policy-learning/BC ceiling, or is there real dynamic range attributable to the generative objective?
reporting_rule: every published table must carry a paradigm column (BC / offline-RL / offline->online) and a test-time NFE column including critic calls

stage_1.purpose: BC floor plus both low-NFE generative objectives
stage_1.seeds: ONE exploratory training seed (42) only; do not launch multiple seeds yet

stage_2.cost_basis: size from the MEASURED 789 ms/plan at 100 NFE on cube-triple, not from linear extrapolation of low-NFE timings. A 60-episode evaluation is ~6.6 h.
stage_2.purpose: multi-step reference, only if stage 1 shows non-trivial performance

task.goal_relabeling: deterministic future state from the same episode only; identical rule to every other OGBench state task

training.checkpoint_selection: final fixed-step EMA checkpoint only; no selection on evaluation episodes

why_this_task.publication_caveat: Neither outcome is automatically publishable. A BC-ceiling null is useful evidence, but its value depends on whether it leads to a new diagnosis or method.
why_this_task.rationale: cube-double has a 40-point spread between the best value method and GCBC, the dynamic range cube-triple lacks entirely (no published method exceeds 4 there).
